title: An Analysis and Survey of the Development of Mutation Testing
problem_or_principle: Organizes mutation-testing development, operators, cost, applications, and open problems.
method_or_proof_style: Systematic historical/taxonomic synthesis rather than a new certificate algorithm.
evidence_or_artifact: Broad literature corpus and taxonomy; no single benchmark claim is treated as universal.
narrative_lesson: Defines terms before organizing techniques by problem and historical development.
relationship_to_this_work: Supplies the field boundary. It does not ask whether one top-k location set is invariant over every quota-feasible mutant subset.

title: A Survey on Software Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Catalogs traditional and advanced fault-localization families, subjects, and metrics.
method_or_proof_style: Survey synthesis with explicit evaluation dimensions.
evidence_or_artifact: Cross-family literature, benchmark and metric comparison.
narrative_lesson: Separates technique families, subjects, and evaluation measures before open issues.
relationship_to_this_work: Constrains our claims: ranking stability under a fixed matrix is not localization accuracy, developer usefulness, or a new suspiciousness family.

title: Using Mutation Analysis for Assessing and Comparing Testing Coverage Criteria
problem_or_principle: Tests whether mutants support trustworthy empirical comparisons of coverage criteria.
method_or_proof_style: Industrial subject, known faults, many mutants, statistical comparison.
evidence_or_artifact: Real and seeded faults, coverage criteria, cost/effectiveness analysis.
narrative_lesson: Motivation and validity question precede protocol and comparative results.
relationship_to_this_work: Motivates caution about what mutation evidence represents. It provides no universal guarantee over quota-constrained samples.

title: A Theoretical and Empirical Study of Diversity-Aware Mutation Adequacy Criterion
problem_or_principle: Defines a diversity-aware adequacy objective based on distinguishing mutants.
method_or_proof_style: Formal criterion plus empirical comparison on test suites.
evidence_or_artifact: Replication package and empirical fault-detection/test-size outcomes.
narrative_lesson: Formal definition first, then empirical questions and trade-offs.
relationship_to_this_work: Its selected object is a test suite and its objective is adequacy/diversity. Our selected object is a mutant subset and our predicate is invariance of a fixed location set.

title: Detecting Trivial Mutant Equivalences via Compiler Optimisations
problem_or_principle: Reduces mutation cost by detecting trivial equivalent or duplicated mutants through compilation.
method_or_proof_style: Static/compiler-based technique with empirical evaluation.
evidence_or_artifact: Multiple programs, optimization levels, equivalent/duplicate reduction outcomes.
narrative_lesson: Technique and mechanism are followed by controlled empirical assessment and limitations.
relationship_to_this_work: Column equality or compiler equivalence alone does not preserve crossing group identities, forced membership, or quota feasibility in our model.

title: Predictive Mutation Testing
problem_or_principle: Predicts killed/survived outcomes without executing every mutant.
method_or_proof_style: Supervised classification in cross-version and cross-project settings.
evidence_or_artifact: 163 projects, AUC/error and efficiency trade-offs.
narrative_lesson: Clearly separates prediction setting, features, scenarios, and empirical results.
relationship_to_this_work: It addresses acquisition cost by estimating missing outcomes. Our certificate assumes the entire declared matrix is fixed and exact; uncertain columns would require a different contract.

title: Sentinel: A Hyper-Heuristic for the Generation of Mutant Reduction Strategies
problem_or_principle: Automates project-specific mutant-reduction strategies under cost/effectiveness objectives.
method_or_proof_style: Multi-objective evolutionary hyper-heuristic with empirical baselines.
evidence_or_artifact: 40 releases of 10 systems and thousands of experiments.
narrative_lesson: Research questions and objective trade-offs drive the evaluation narrative.
relationship_to_this_work: Sentinel optimizes reduction quality empirically. It does not certify that every policy-feasible sample preserves a supplied localization report.

title: Cerebro: Static Subsuming Mutant Selection
problem_or_principle: Selects likely subsuming mutants from surrounding code context.
method_or_proof_style: Machine learning with cross-project evaluation in C and Java.
evidence_or_artifact: 58 programs, subsumption/equivalence/execution-cost measures.
narrative_lesson: Mechanism, learning setup, baselines and threats are explicitly separated.
relationship_to_this_work: Subsuming-mutant selection pursues testing strength and cost. Our identity-sensitive quota predicate may be broken by merging behaviorally identical mutants.

title: An Empirical Study of Fault Localization Families and Their Combinations
access_basis: author full text and tool route
problem_or_principle: Compares multiple localization families and their combinations on real faults.
method_or_proof_style: Large comparative empirical study including execution cost.
evidence_or_artifact: Real-world faults and a released combination/evaluation implementation.
narrative_lesson: Family taxonomy motivates combined evaluation and measured outcomes.
relationship_to_this_work: Provides the appropriate effectiveness context. Our work fixes one score and offers no evidence of superior fault-location accuracy.

title: Historical Spectrum Based Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Uses version history to augment spectra and break suspiciousness ties.
method_or_proof_style: History-derived model plus Defects4J evaluation.
evidence_or_artifact: Top-k, MAP, MRR, and comparisons with several families.
narrative_lesson: Motivating limitations lead to a new information source and benchmark evaluation.
relationship_to_this_work: Changes the evidence and ranking method to improve effectiveness. We hold both fixed and certify robustness only over a declared sample family.

title: Overcoming the Equivalent Mutant Problem: A Systematic Literature Review and a Comparative Experiment of Second Order Mutation
problem_or_principle: Synthesizes and compares approaches to the equivalent-mutant problem.
method_or_proof_style: Systematic review plus controlled comparative experiment.
evidence_or_artifact: Classified literature and second-order mutation evidence.
narrative_lesson: Review protocol is made explicit before the comparative experiment.
relationship_to_this_work: Supports the warning that mutant equivalence is a separate semantic/cost issue. Our checker neither detects equivalence nor treats survival as proof of equivalence.

title: The ManyBugs and IntroClass Benchmarks for Automated Repair of C Programs
problem_or_principle: Builds curated C benchmarks with reproducible faults and tests.
method_or_proof_style: Benchmark construction, characterization, and repair-tool case studies.
evidence_or_artifact: Real faults in C projects plus reproducibility infrastructure.
narrative_lesson: Benchmark definition and curation evidence precede downstream experiments.
relationship_to_this_work: Shows what a real-defect evaluation would require. Our owned generated C schemas provide pipeline assurance but are not a substitute for such a benchmark.

title: Hints on Test Data Selection: Help for the Practicing Programmer
problem_or_principle: Introduces the competent-programmer and coupling intuitions behind mutation testing.
method_or_proof_style: Conceptual argument with examples.
evidence_or_artifact: Foundational rather than benchmark-scale evidence.
narrative_lesson: Problem intuition and testing implications dominate the narrative.
relationship_to_this_work: Historical foundation only; it neither defines mutant-sampling quotas nor a checkable ranking-stability proposition.

title: Empirical Evaluation of the Tarantula Automatic Fault-Localization Technique
problem_or_principle: Ranks statements from passing/failing coverage spectra and evaluates debugging guidance.
method_or_proof_style: Spectrum formula plus empirical study.
evidence_or_artifact: Standard program suites and inspection-effort measures.
narrative_lesson: Technique is motivated by visualization and evaluated through ranked inspection.
relationship_to_this_work: Defines a landmark ranking context. Our squared-Ochiai mutant score and maximum aggregation are fixed inputs, not a proposed successor to Tarantula.

title: On the Accuracy of Spectrum-Based Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Compares similarity coefficients, including Ochiai, for fault localization.
method_or_proof_style: Empirical formula comparison.
evidence_or_artifact: Benchmark faults and ranking accuracy.
narrative_lesson: A focused formula question leads directly to comparative results.
relationship_to_this_work: Supplies the score family we freeze. It does not address sample-family quantification or certificate checking.

title: Metallaxis-FL: Mutation-Based Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Links mutant behavior to faulty program locations for localization.
method_or_proof_style: Mutation-based suspiciousness with empirical and controlled evaluation.
evidence_or_artifact: Program subjects, cost-reduction settings and localization outcomes.
narrative_lesson: Method, experiments and practical implications are clearly separated.
relationship_to_this_work: The closest application lineage. We preserve its kind of mutant evidence but study a post-hoc universal robustness question, not a new localization score.

title: Ask the Mutants: Mutating Faulty Programs for Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Uses behavioral changes from mutating faulty programs to localize faults.
method_or_proof_style: Mutation-based method with comparative evaluation.
evidence_or_artifact: Benchmark programs and ranking outcomes.
narrative_lesson: Assumption, technique, evaluation and comparison form a concise conference narrative.
relationship_to_this_work: Demonstrates that mutation-localization semantics differ across methods. Our certificate is tied to the supplied binary kill matrix and does not generalize to repair-oriented observations.

title: Evaluating and Improving Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Reassesses localization techniques and improves evaluation realism.
method_or_proof_style: Large comparative evaluation with explicit fault spaces and metrics.
evidence_or_artifact: Real faults, multiple families, released infrastructure.
narrative_lesson: Starts from evaluation weaknesses, then reports corrected comparisons.
relationship_to_this_work: Directly motivates our narrow nonclaims: finite ranking invariance cannot be interpreted as real-fault effectiveness.

title: Transforming Programs and Tests in Tandem for Fault Localization
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages 1(OOPSLA), Article 92
problem_or_principle: Transforms programs and tests together to expose better localization signals.
method_or_proof_style: Semantics-aware transformations and empirical evaluation.
evidence_or_artifact: Benchmark defects and localization improvements.
narrative_lesson: Formal transformation intuition is connected to an empirical pipeline.
relationship_to_this_work: Changes program/test evidence to improve ranking. Our problem is post-observation and leaves programs, tests and scores unchanged.

title: Are Mutation Scores Correlated with Real Fault Detection?
problem_or_principle: Separates mutation score, test-suite size and real-fault detection relationships.
method_or_proof_style: Large-scale empirical correlation/causal-control analysis.
evidence_or_artifact: Real faults, mutants and test suites at scale.
narrative_lesson: Claims are qualified by confounding and validity analysis.
relationship_to_this_work: Supports our refusal to infer fault-detection quality from an exact matrix certificate.

title: Evaluating the Impact of Experimental Assumptions in Automated Fault Localization
problem_or_principle: Measures how patch/root-cause and evaluation assumptions change localization conclusions.
method_or_proof_style: Controlled re-evaluation under multiple assumptions.
evidence_or_artifact: Real faults and sensitivity of reported effectiveness.
narrative_lesson: Assumptions are made first-class experimental factors.
relationship_to_this_work: Motivates explicit tie, floor, reference-set and corpus assumptions and prevents us from presenting one operationalization as universal debugging utility.

title: Certifying Algorithms
problem_or_principle: Surveys algorithms that return easily checked witnesses of correctness.
method_or_proof_style: Theory and design principles with examples across algorithmic problems.
evidence_or_artifact: Proof objects and independent checker patterns rather than a software-debugging corpus.
narrative_lesson: Separates producer complexity from simple verification obligations.
relationship_to_this_work: Provides the certificate design lens. Our contribution is a problem-specific branch/cut packet and checker, not a new general certification framework.
